gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar-squ: Noto Sans Zanabazar Square keeps tiny sizes crisp with wide gaps. Righteous pours out bowls that fill the line in rod-thin strokes, and the tall-lowercase body gives the eye somewhere gentle to rest.
gen-righteous-gf-orienta: Bowls fill the line, each letter bent from thin steel rod. The sharpest thing here is temperament: Righteous commands, while Orienta's counters breathe and its lowercase nearly matches its capitals.
gen-righteous-gf-preahvihear: Preahvihear lets its letter mouths gape wide beneath a lofty x-height, so paragraphs would feel spacious and thoroughly unhurried. Righteous supplies the show overhead, its line gliding like wire.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-radio-canada: Goldman spreads wide, bold letters with round forms like open parentheses. Radio Canada then runs a steady, pressure-free line with full, tall c, s and z, so paragraphs would read smoothly.
gen-tourney-gf-hind-vadodara: Stretched out, stocky, and unmistakably athletic. Tourney shouts in wide-tracked, uniform strokes, then Hind Vadodara follows with spacious terminal gaps and tall-bowled e and a, keeping the text open.
gen-tourney-gf-kedebideri: Bulky, stretched-out letters with no thin strokes to vanish in glare. Tourney carries the whole shout while Kedebideri's skyward x-height and rounded, inviting letters keep the text approachable beneath it.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart. Tourney does loud, wide-tracked, one-width impact best, while the body's tall, full c, s and z do quiet, clean reading best.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-anatolian-hiero: Blunt marker tips, stretched wide and stocky. Tourney is best at loud, round-tipped impact, while Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs is best at outward-pointing terminals and an x-height rising close to cap height.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-carian: Neon-tube letters, glowing at a single line thickness. Tourney is built to glow and shout, while Noto Sans Carian keeps terminals apart like open scissor blades for quieter, tidier text.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-chorasmian: Bent tubing, bold and stretched: that is Tourney. Noto Sans Chorasmian counters with one standout quality: its large x-height under short ascenders, so text stays open and quiet.
